intent: Establish paired scientific workload intent and documentation-only boundaries without choosing a translation or starting port work.

fields.purpose: scVelo and CellRank are reference workloads for discovering reusable Cellerator/Baseplane primitives and eventual scientific demonstrations. Upstream algorithms are evidence, not architecture; preserve scientific and numerical meaning.
fields.ownership: Cellerator owns general state, relation, graph, statistical, numerical and iterative computation. Baseplane owns intrinsically sequence-grounded computation only.
fields.scope: Documentation and project setup only. No selected translation strategy, port, kernel, library implementation, experiment, benchmark or data processing. No port run is active.
fields.design_context: docs/library-design-probes.md in registered repositories cellrank and scvelo; use AGENTS.md for workflow and delegation guidance.
